title: 看病购药与紧急求助
description: 覆盖身体不适、药店咨询、就医沟通、保险信息和紧急求助场景。

data.chinese: 附近有营业中的药店吗？
data.english: Is there a pharmacy open nearby?

data.chinese: 我从今天早上开始一直头疼。
data.english: I have had a headache since this morning.
Do I need a prescription for this medicine?
How often should I take it?

data.chinese: 我的朋友呼吸困难，请叫救护车。
data.english: My friend is having trouble breathing, so please call an ambulance.

data.chinese: 我需要一位会说英语的医生。
data.english: I need a doctor who speaks English.

data.chinese: 这是我的旅行保险信息。
data.english: Here is my travel insurance information.
Where is the nearest emergency room?

data.chinese: 我现在感觉好多了，谢谢你的帮助。
data.english: I feel much better now, thank you for your help.
